title: Dream Weaver | Santa Rosa Beach, FL | Five Star Properties
meta_description: Dream Weaver - Vacation Rental in Blue Mountain BeachFavorite Features:- Gulf View- Private Pool- Gated Entrance
description_expanded: Dream Weaver - Vacation Rental in Blue Mountain Beach Favorite Features: - Gulf View - Private Pool - Gated Entrance - Grill on Property - 4 Included Bikes - Complimentary Beach Chairs (In-Season) - 3-Minute Walk to Beach More about Dream Weaver: Gulf views abound from this tastefully appointed and spacious 30A beach home. Take a short stroll to the beach or stay close to home and enjoy your own private pool. No expense was spared with deep plantation shutters, crown moldings, painted wood ceilings, stunning French accents, and gorgeous hardwood and marble flooring throughout the entire 4450 square feet of this extraordinary home. Enjoy maximum privacy with the walled and private gated entrance to the home.   The first floor houses the majority of the home’s sleeping quarters. Follow the marble flooring down a beautiful, wide hallway to arrive at the first of the home’s Master Suites. The first floor Master has a King bed, a twin bed, a flat-screen TV, a walk-in closet, and access to the pool patio. The Master Bath features two sinks, a walk-in shower, a private water closet, and a jetted tub. A Queen Suite is also located on the first floor. With a flat-screen TV, pool patio access, and a private full bath with a tub and a standalone shower, the Queen Suite is very accommodating. Also located on the first floor is a spacious King Suite. The first floor King Suite has a flat-screen TV and a private full bath with a walk-in shower. An additional half bath and the laundry room with high-efficiency appliances round out the first floor.   Located off of the first floor there is an abundance of patio space and a private in-ground pool. The pool features a Baja deck and plenty of privacy. The patio features seating on couches, a porch swing, and lounge chairs, al fresco dining seating for five, and a sound system.   Guests will be welcomed to the second floor by an open living area boasting Gulf views. The living room has seating for six, a large flat screen TV, and a Blu-ray player. The deck off of the living room features views of the Gulf and the surrounding community of Santa Rosa Beach, outdoor seating, and a grill. Adjacent to the living room, the entertainment room hosts a wet bar, a mini-fridge, a private balcony, seating for five, and a flat-screen TV with a Blu-ray player. Dream Weaver’s kitchen is complete with stainless steel appliances and a professional range. Next to the kitchen, the formal dining area seats eight. There is a half bath located off the open living area for guest’s convenience. The second floor also hosts a King Suite with a King bed, a flat-screen TV, and a full private bath with a shower/tub combo.   The entire third floor of Dream Weaver is dedicated to another Master Suite. The third floor Master features a King bed, two twin beds, a seating area for ten, a flat screen TV, two balconies, a bar with a mini-fridge, a large walk-in closet, and unimpeded Gulf views. The third floor Master also boasts two full baths, one with dual sinks and a walk-in shower, and the second with a shower/tub combo.   The eclectic décor, top-of-line amenities, Gulf views, and privacy that Dream Weaver offer, make it a one-of-a-kind home on the Emerald Coast. Dream Weaver also offers a private beach access walk right off of the back porch. Enjoy the private pool to the fullest by requesting the pool to be heated for an additional charge. Book your stay at Dream Weaver today, a place where dreams are woven into reality. *Fireplaces are a seasonal feature that can only be utilized from October through April. Fireplaces will not be in working order from May to September.  Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 2: Queen Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. Bedroom 3: King Bed, Twin Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 4: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 5: King Bed, 2 Twin Beds with Private Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower.
